`localStorage.setItem` throws when the browser refuses storage access (site data blocked in its settings, or a sandboxed frame) and when the storage quota is full. The arguments cannot prevent this, and a browser with storage allowed and space free will never show it. No `try`/`catch` covers this call, so the exception propagates out of this function.

`nombresCombustible` is a table of fixed entries, and this asks it about a key the code did not choose. Indexing answers "what does this name resolve to", which on an ordinary object includes everything the language put there before the author's own keys — so a key like `constructor` comes back with a value, and it is neither absent nor falsy. Testing the RESULT cannot separate the two cases; only asking whether the key is one of the table's OWN can. Use a presence test, or a map that holds only what was put in it.
